title: PAY-002 Commerce Order API Candidate Admission Gate
purpose: Tracks admission and implementation evidence for the Commerce Order create/read API; contract admission does not enable public runtime routes.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Canonical OpenAPI contains both operations with closed DTO schemas, common error envelopes and an explicit request-body budget.

order.create and order.read are admitted to the canonical permission catalog with own scope, L2 minimum layer, and explicit verified_user/admin/super_admin grants; runtime owner-isolation tests remain separately required.
W07 resolves every submitted itemRef to an authoritative purchasable item/offer, immutable version and current price; unsupported/unavailable items fail closed.

The closed create/read response DTO properties map to canonical ENT-ORDER and ENT-ORDER-LINE fields or explicit transport/relation sources; customerId, internal persistence columns, raw snapshot JSON, provider data, ledger rows and entitlement snapshots are excluded.

The canonical D1-04 UUID and Wrangler display name matched current read-only Cloudflare inventory; a source-commit schema snapshot was collected. This is identity/schema discovery evidence only and does not authorize any migration or runtime write.
A separately reviewed D1-04 migration candidate and exact post-migration schema/constraint evidence must pass before runtime writes are enabled.

driftedPins.change: Legacy validate-review-state step was retired after the W07 Neon-only runtime cleanup.
The local-only shared-runner review record was refreshed; it still blocks new remote shared-runner DDL.
Legacy D1_01/D1_04 runtime labels were removed and Hyperdrive aliases renamed to HYPERDRIVE_MEMBERSHIP_DB/HYPERDRIVE_FINANCE_DB; the finance Hyperdrive id is unchanged.

evidence.scopeLimit: This admission covers the existing historical D1-04 schema-only remote application and exact postflight readback. It does not authorize new remote DDL, the shared D1-04 runner (which remains local-only/remote-apply-blocked), business-data import, production cutover, production charging, refunds, payouts or settlements. Cloudflare D1 was not touched by the schema apply; runtime/production cutover remains separately gated.

requiredEvidence.requirement: Same key and same semantic request replays the original response; same key with a different request hash is rejected atomically with order creation.
Route enforces bounded request-body size, item-count/quantity limits and existing W01/W07 anti-abuse controls before any D1 write.
Exact-commit tests cover create/read, malformed/unknown fields, price spoofing, missing key, replay/key-reuse conflict, owner isolation, unavailable items, concurrency and recovery.
Schema, migration, security and runtime evidence is admitted against the exact implementation commit; PAY-002 stays unresolved until downstream mapping checks pass.

greenRule: This gate cannot be GREEN while any implementation evidence is PENDING; canonical contract admission is distinct from runtime/production admission, and PAY-002 remains unresolved.
nextAction: Complete IDEMPOTENCY-01 and ITEM-RESOLUTION-01 admission against exact main (their evidence PRs remain open and unmerged), then close ABUSE-01 and E2E-SECURITY-01. Record EVIDENCE-REGISTRY-01 only after all prerequisite gates are admitted. Keep W07 live order writes fail-closed while authoritative live discount/tax pricing and seller-of-record decisions remain unresolved.
